content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(Akira ESXi Interactive Shell From vCenter-Initiated Session) AND BIOC(Akira ESXi Syslog Redirected to Ephemeral tmp for Log Blinding) AND ABIOC(Akira ESXi Offline VMDK Credential-Theft Pivot) AND ABIOC(Akira ESXi Mass Guest Power-Off Fan-Out From Blinded Host) AND BIOC(Akira v2 VM-Only Encryption Impact on ESXi Datastore) within 6h stitched on the shared causality_actor_process_instance_id and the cloned-VMDK entity — auto-promotes to one P1 hypervisor-ransomware incident.
rules.name: Akira vCenter-to-ESXi Hypervisor Ransomware Kill Chain
